description: This file generates PDFs for AOS PDF templates within a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment, supporting both PDF creation and email distribution. It handles template parsing, line item population, and integrates with the PDF engine and email functionality.

methods.name: populate_group_lines
methods.description: Populates template text with grouped line items based on line item groups and products or services.

methods.name: populate_product_lines
methods.description: Populates template text with product line items, handling placeholder replacements.

methods.name: populate_service_lines
methods.description: Populates template text with service line items, replacing placeholders accordingly.
